Questo ti rende unico

- Apprendistato completato nel campo dell'ingegneria/costruzione/giardino e/o prova di pratica nel campo della manutenzione degli edifici, della manutenzione delle macchine, della costruzione o dell'assistenza ambientale

- Personalità flessibile con un metodo di lavoro coscienzioso e indipendente, nonché la volontà di svolgere missioni e interventi di piquette al di fuori dell'orario di lavoro e missioni speciali nei campi d'aviazione militari

- Patente di guida categoria B e buona conoscenza IT

- Comportamento orientato al cliente e al team con una forte idea di servizio

Offriamo questo

- Siamo impegnati al modello di successo Svizzera e lavoriamo a beneficio della popolazione.

- Grazie alle pari opportunità, sviluppiamo le nostre competenze e realizziamo prospettive diverse.

- Salute sul lavoro Sosteniamo e consigliamo i nostri dipendenti nel campo della salute fisica e mentale.

Il vostro impegno per la sicurezza e la libertà
La base logistica dell'esercito svizzero (LBA) è lì per la forza. Fornisce tutti i servizi logistici per l'esercito svizzero e gestisce i materiali, i sistemi e le infrastrutture dell'esercito svizzero con i suoi circa 3'500 dipendenti e 12.000 membri della milizia. Sia nel laboratorio o in ufficio, all'interno o all'esterno: L'LBA offre una vasta gamma di posti di lavoro in tutta la Svizzera. Abbiamo qualcosa per tutti.

L'esercito svizzero impiega più di 9.000 persone in quattro militari e circa 200 occupazioni civili – in 110 sedi in tutta la Svizzera. La prossima generazione si occupa anche di: L'esercito svizzero addestra gli studenti in più di 30 professioni.

Svuotare l'esercito svizzero ha senso e porta molti vantaggi. Convincetevi di Army.ch/vantages.

## Put to the Point

As an employee you ensure the smooth operation of our buildings, facilities, objects and areas including all technical facilities. You can expect a unique working environment with varied tasks as well as the opportunity to use your expertise in a targeted manner and continuously develop it.

- Entry date: by agreement
- Type of employment: perpetual
- Reference No: JRQ$540-20449
- Location: Rotbuchstrasse 3, 8600 Dübendorf

You can make this contribution

- Responsible for the operation, monitoring, control and regulation of technical equipment in the field of heating, air conditioning, filters, ventilation, water and energy supply and monitor and maintain the entire technical equipment for functionality and safety

- Carry out maintenance, maintenance, cleaning, repair and inspection work

- Elaborate defect lists and documents for billing for damaged or lost material

- Monitoring and implementing environmental work, black ice control and snow clearance

- Perform barriers, installation and clean-up at the assigned shooting sites and training facilities

This makes you unique

- Completed apprenticeship in the field of engineering/construction/garden construction and/or successful proof of practice in the fields of building maintenance, machine maintenance, construction or environmental care

- Flexible personality with a conscientious and independent working method as well as the willingness to carry out piquette missions and interventions outside working hours and special missions at military airfields

- Driving licence category B and good IT knowledge

- Customer and team-oriented behavior with a strong service idea

We offer this

- We are committed to the success model Switzerland and work for the benefit of the population.

- Thanks to equal opportunities, we develop our skills and bring in different perspectives.

- Healthy at work We support and advise our employees in the field of physical and mental health.

Your commitment to security and freedom
The logistics base of the Swiss Army (LBA) is there for the force. It provides all logistical services for the Swiss army and manages the materials, systems and infrastructure of the Swiss army with its approximately 3'500 employees and 12,000 militia members. Whether in the workshop or in the office, inside or outside: The LBA offers a wide range of workplaces throughout Switzerland. We have something for everyone.

## Additional information

Employing the Swiss Army makes sense and brings many advantages. Convince yourself of Army.ch/advantages.
Offers from recruiters are not taken into account.

Women are still underrepresented in our administrative unit. Your applications are therefore particularly welcome.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Put to the Point

Are you a technology freak, enjoy military and special vehicles and also want to benefit from a pronounced work-life balance in your job? Then strengthen our team, because together we contribute to making our special and wheeled vehicles of the Swiss Army and Air Force ready for use and functional.

- Entry date: by agreement
- Type of employment: perpetual
- Reference No: JRQ$540-18390
- Place of work: Military airfield, 8600 Dübendorf

You can make this contribution

- Carry out repair, diagnosis and adjustment work on engine, drive groups, brakes, steering, chassis, sub-assemblies and safety and comfort electronics

- Check and repair defects and repairs on special and wheeled vehicles

- Carry out maintenance and deadline work on special and wheeled vehicles

- Provide technical support for material transfers and material take-backs with regard to driving safety, accident prevention, maintenance, cleaning and vehicle inventory in our own area

- Capture defect messages and spare parts in the SAP system

- Army personnel (Ada) in charge

This makes you unique

- Completed vocational training as an automotive mechatronics specialist, specialisation in commercial vehicles or related professions

- Driving licence of the Kat C, Kat CE and SUVA recognized forklift

- Self-employed, forward working methods, with good organizational skills

- Good comprehension of technical relationships and analytical ability

- Pronounced service concept in contact with and in advising customers, for example the troop

We offer this

- We are committed to the success model Switzerland and work for the benefit of the population.

- Thanks to equal opportunities, we develop our skills and bring in different perspectives.

- Healthy at work We support and advise our employees in the field of physical and mental health.

Your commitment to security and freedom
The logistics base of the Swiss Army (LBA) is there for the force. It provides all logistical services for the Swiss army and manages the materials, systems and infrastructure of the Swiss army with its approximately 3'500 employees and 12,000 militia members. Whether in the workshop or in the office, inside or outside: The LBA offers a wide range of workplaces throughout Switzerland. We have something for everyone.

The Swiss Army employs more than 9,000 people in four military and around 200 civilian occupations – at 110 locations throughout Switzerland. The next generation is also taken care of: The Swiss Army trains learners in more than 30 professions.

## Additional information

Employing the Swiss Army makes sense and brings many advantages. Convince yourself of Army.ch/advantages.
Offers from recruiters are not taken into account.

Women are still underrepresented in our administrative unit. Your applications are therefore particularly welcome.

In a constantly changing security situation, it is all the more important to recognize connections before others see them. By analyzing, interpreting and prioritizing information from various sources, you create the situational picture, identify risks and create the basis for preventive protective measures to be targeted and effective.
The Service for Preventive Protection of the Army (DPSA) forms the first line of defense of the army. It monitors and assesses the military security situation and takes precautionary measures to protect the army from espionage, sabotage and other illegal acts.

- Entry date: by agreement
- Type of employment: perpetual
- Reference No: JRQ$540-20331
- Location: Papiermühlestrasse 20, 3003 Bern

You can make this contribution

- Creating, analysing and communicating a situational picture of the entire range of operations of the Army Preventive Protection Service (DPSA)

- Interpret, compare, consolidate and evaluate data, identify gaps in the situational picture and derive targeted measures to close them

- Analyze threats such as espionage, sabotage and other illegal acts as well as develop preventive protection concepts and measures

- Develop intelligence products and decision-making bases for the operational level and represent the military defence situation in specialist committees

- Continuously monitor, assess and prepare the internal security situation of the army in accordance with target groups

This makes them unique.

- Officer in the Swiss Army (minor lieutenant), specialised training as intelligence officer

- University/specialist university degree (preferably in political science, criminology, law or psychology) or multi-year functional professional experience in the intelligence service/state protection or police sector

- Experience and competencies at operational level (staff work)

- Strong analytical, methodological and editorial competence as well as step-oriented communication

- Good oral and written knowledge of a second official language and good knowledge of English

We offer this

- We are committed to the success model Switzerland and work for the benefit of the population.

- Thanks to equal opportunities, we develop our skills and bring in different perspectives.

- Healthy at work We support and advise our employees in the field of physical and mental health.

Your commitment to security and freedom
The Command Operations (Kdo Op) is responsible for all military operations and operations of the Swiss Army. The Kdo Op includes the Luftwaffe, the Army, the four territorial divisions, the SWISSINT Competence Center, the Special Forces Command and the Military Police. Around 40% of the approximately 2,500 employees are civil employees – from engineers to aircraft mechanics to analysts.

Employing the Swiss army makes sense and brings many advantages. Convince yourself ofarmee.ch/advantages.

jobs.description:
## Auf den Punkt gebracht

Dein Herz schlägt für Informatik? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.
Trage dazu bei, dass die Informatik der Schweizer Armee sicher und zuverlässig läuft. Du richtest IT-Systeme ein, betreust Netzwerke, löst technische Probleme und hilfst mit, Systeme vor Cyberangriffen zu schützen. Nach einem externen Basislehrjahr, in dem du die IT-Grundlagen erlernst, startest du bei uns direkt in die Praxis. Dich erwarten spannende Projekte, abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und viel Raum, um Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Praxisbildende begleiten dich dabei Schritt für Schritt bis zum erfolgreichen Lehrabschluss.

- Eintrittsdatum: 01.08.2027
- Anstellungsart: befristet
- Referenz-Nr.: JRQ$540-19601
- Arbeitsort: Stauffacherstrasse 65, 3014 Bern

Diesen Beitrag kannst du leisten

- Moderne IT-Systeme installieren, konfigurieren, einrichten und betreiben

- Netzwerke und Server überwachen und stabilen Betrieb sicherstellen

- Technische Störungen effizient analysieren und beheben

- Geräte, Daten und Systeme vor Cyberangriffen schützen und Cybersicherheit aktiv unterstützen

- Bei spannenden IT-Projekten mitwirken, neue Technologien und Lösungen im Alltag testen

Das macht dich einzigartig

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossene obligatorische Schulzeit (Sekundarstufe oder höher)

- Neugier, Drive und Motivation, Neues zu lernen und dich weiterzuentwickeln

- Begeisterung für Informatik, Technologie und digitale Trends

- Vernetztes Denken sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise

- Fokus und Durchhaltevermögen bei anspruchsvollen Aufgaben

- Eigeninitiative, Teamgeist und den Willen, etwas zu bewegen

Das bieten wir

- Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.

- Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.

- Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.

Vielfalt, Dynamik, Perspektiven – Lehrberufe der Schweizer Armee
Das Kommando Cyber (Kdo Cy) steht für Kompetenz in den Bereichen Cyber und Digitalisierung. Wir vereinen die Begeisterung für unsere Aufgabe mit Know-how, Innovation, modernsten Technologien und agilen Arbeitsweisen. Wir erbringen sichere, robuste und resiliente Informatikleistungen für die Schweizer Armee und unsere Partner im Sicherheitsverbund Schweiz. Damit ermöglicht das Kdo Cy der Schweizer Armee den notwendigen Wissens- und Entscheidvorsprung – für eine sichere Schweiz.

Die Schweizer Armee beschäftigt über 9'000 Mitarbeitende in vier militärischen und rund 200 zivilen Berufen – und dies an 110 Standorten schweizweit. Auch für den Nachwuchs ist gesorgt: Die Schweizer Armee bildet in über 30 Berufen Lernende aus.

## Zusätzliche Informationen

Eine Lehre bei der Schweizer Armee macht Sinn und bringt viele Vorteile mit sich. Überzeuge dich auf www.armee.ch/lehre

Frauen sowie Personen aus der französischen und der italienischen Sprachengemeinschaft sind in unserer Verwaltungseinheit noch untervertreten. Ihre Bewerbungen sind daher besonders willkommen.

Avec d'autres apprenants, vous travaillez dans une jeune équipe de cuisine et préparez des repas pour l'équipe et les recrues.
Vous pouvez vous attendre à une éducation intéressante et variée avec des horaires de travail flexibles. Nous prenons notre temps et vous soutenons dans votre temps d'enseignement.
Avec des concours de cuisine, une formation interne et des cours de préparation au QV, nous vous encourageons et vous défions. Grâce à des stages réguliers dans la restauration civile et dans les entreprises de formation à la transformation des aliments (tels que boulangeries, boucheries ou fromageries), vous développerez votre expertise et vos compétences.

- Date d'entrée: 01.08.2027
- Type d'emploi: temporaire
- Numéro de référence: JRQ540-19481$
- Lieu: Caserne DCA, 1530 Payerne

Vous pouvez faire cette contribution

- Planification et coordination des tâches

- Vérifier la qualité et la quantité des aliments livrés

- Aider à la préparation des repas

- Aider à la distribution et au service des aliments

- Créez indépendamment vos propres recettes et plats

Cela vous rend unique

- Joy dans la préparation des plats et la manipulation des aliments

- Bon sens de l'odeur et du goût

- Travail d'équipe et créativité; Appréciation du français et de l'anglais

- Personne résiliente qui reste équilibrée même dans des situations agitées

- Achèvement de la scolarité obligatoire en été 2027

Nous offrons ceci

- Nous sommes attachés au modèle de réussite Suisse et travaillons au profit de la population.

- Grâce à l'égalité des chances, nous développons nos compétences et apportons différentes perspectives.

- Santé au travail Nous soutenons et conseillons nos employés dans le domaine de la santé physique et mentale.

Diversité, dynamisme, perspectives – professions enseignantes de l'armée suisse
Les opérations de commandement (Kdo Op) sont responsables de toutes les opérations militaires de l'armée suisse. L'opération Kdo comprend la Luftwaffe, l'armée, les quatre divisions territoriales, le Centre de compétence SWISSINT, le Commandement des forces spéciales et la police militaire. Environ 40 % des quelque 2 500 employés sont des employés civils – des ingénieurs aux mécaniciens d'aéronefs aux analystes.

L'armée suisse emploie plus de 9 000 personnes dans quatre professions militaires et environ 200 emplois civils – dans 110 localités à travers la Suisse. La prochaine génération est également prise en charge: L'Armée suisse forme les apprenants dans plus de 30 professions.

## Informations complémentaires

Votre lieu de travail et d'apprentissage est le Waffenplatzküche Payerne au CH-1530 Payerne.
Un apprentissage avec l'armée suisse a du sens et apporte de nombreux avantages. Avec nous, vous bénéficiez d'un réseau complet et de la diversité linguistique des militaires. Les compétences en leadership et en formation ainsi que le soutien professionnel complet font partie de nos forces. Convainquez-vous sur www.armee.ch/lehre.

jobs.title: 3 Lernende Logistiker/-innen EFZ, Fachrichtung Lager
jobs.description:
## Auf den Punkt gebracht

Du interessierst dich für moderne Fördermittel und Lagersysteme, kannst dir vorstellen in hektischen Situationen den Überblick zu behalten und Kunden/Kundinnen mit dem gewünschten Material zu bedienen? Organisation, Datenmanagement und der direkte Kontakt zu Kunden/Kundinnen interessieren dich? Dann ist die abwechslungsreiche 3-jährige Ausbildung bei uns genau das Richtige.

- Eintrittsdatum: 01.08.2027
- Anstellungsart: befristet
- Referenz-Nr.: JRQ$540-19448
- Arbeitsort: Route du PAA, 1772 Grolley

Diesen Beitrag kannst du leisten

- Güter entgegennehmen, kontrollieren und im Computersystem verbuchen, Lieferpapiere und Daten prüfen und die Waren fachgerecht lagern

- Lagerbestände überprüfen, Umlagerungen durchführen, Waren für Kundenbestellungen zusammenstellen (kommissionieren), durch den Lagerbetrieb transportieren und für die Auslieferung vorbereiten

- Die Waren fachgerecht verpacken, verladen und in Last- oder Bahnwagen sichern

- Die Kundschaft direkt am Schalter oder der Rampe bedienen

- Versände per Post ausführen

Das macht dich einzigartig

- Abgeschlossene obligatorische Schulzeit (Sekundarstufe oder 10. Schuljahr) mit guten Noten in den mathematischen Fächern

- Logisches Denkvermögen und exakte Arbeitsweise

- Zuverlässigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

- Teamfähigkeit und gute Umgangsformen

- Robuste körperliche Verfassung

Das bieten wir

- Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.

- Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.

- Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.

Vielfalt, Dynamik, Perspektiven – Lehrberufe der Schweizer Armee
Die Logistikbasis der Schweizer Armee (LBA) ist für die Truppe da. Sie erbringt sämtliche logistische Leistungen für die Schweizer Armee und bewirtschaftet mit ihren rund 3'500 Mitarbeitenden und 12'000 Milizangehörigen das Material, die Systeme und die Infrastrukturen der Schweizer Armee. Ob in der Werkstatt oder im Büro, ob drinnen oder draussen: Die LBA bietet schweizweit ein breites Spektrum an Arbeitsplätzen. Bei uns ist für alle etwas dabei.

Die Schweizer Armee beschäftigt über 9'000 Mitarbeitende in vier militärischen und rund 200 zivilen Berufen – und dies an 110 Standorten schweizweit. Auch für den Nachwuchs ist gesorgt: Die Schweizer Armee bildet in über 30 Berufen Lernende aus.

## Zusätzliche Informationen

Eine Lehre bei der Schweizer Armee macht Sinn und bringt viele Vorteile mit sich. Weitere Informationen, Virtual Reality Videos und Portraits unserer Lernenden findest du unter www.armee.ch/lehre.

Frauen sind in unserer Verwaltungseinheit noch untervertreten. Ihre Bewerbungen sind daher besonders willkommen.

titleByLocale.fr: 3 Apprentissage logistique EFZ, entrepôt de spécialisation

descriptionByLocale.it:
## Metti al punto

Siete interessati ai moderni sistemi di trasporto e di stoccaggio, potete immaginare di tenere una panoramica in situazioni frenetiche e servire i clienti con il materiale desiderato? Sei interessato all'organizzazione, alla gestione dei dati e al contatto diretto con i clienti? Poi la formazione di 3 anni varia con noi è esattamente la cosa giusta.

- Data di entrata: 01.08.2027
- Tipo di lavoro: temporaneo
- Numero di riferimento: JRQ$540-19448
- Ubicazione: Route du PAA, 1772 Grolley

Puoi dare questo contributo

- Accettare le merci, controllarle e registrarle nel sistema informatico, controllare i documenti di consegna e i dati e memorizzare le merci correttamente

- Ispezionare le scorte, effettuare delocalizzazioni, assemblare merci per ordini del cliente (picking), trasportarle attraverso il funzionamento del magazzino e prepararle per la consegna

- Imballaggio, carico e sicurezza delle merci correttamente in camion o carri ferroviari

- Servire il cliente direttamente al banco o alla rampa

- Esecuzione per posta

Questo ti rende unico

- Completata la scuola obbligatoria (livello secondario o 10 ° anno scolastico) con buoni voti in materie matematiche

- pensiero logico e metodi di lavoro precisi

- Affidabilità e responsabilità

- Lavoro di squadra e buone maniere

- Robusto stato fisico

Offriamo questo

- Siamo impegnati al modello di successo Svizzera e lavoriamo a beneficio della popolazione.

- Grazie alle pari opportunità, sviluppiamo le nostre competenze e realizziamo prospettive diverse.

- Salute sul lavoro Sosteniamo e consigliamo i nostri dipendenti nel campo della salute fisica e mentale.

Diversità, dinamismo, prospettive – professioni didattiche dell'esercito svizzero
La base logistica dell'esercito svizzero (LBA) è lì per la forza. Fornisce tutti i servizi logistici per l'esercito svizzero e gestisce i materiali, i sistemi e le infrastrutture dell'esercito svizzero con i suoi circa 3'500 dipendenti e 12.000 membri della milizia. Sia nel laboratorio o in ufficio, all'interno o all'esterno: L'LBA offre una vasta gamma di posti di lavoro in tutta la Svizzera. Abbiamo qualcosa per tutti.

L'esercito svizzero impiega più di 9.000 persone in quattro militari e circa 200 occupazioni civili – in 110 sedi in tutta la Svizzera. La prossima generazione si occupa anche di: L'esercito svizzero addestra gli studenti in più di 30 professioni.

## Ulteriori informazioni

Un apprendistato con l'esercito svizzero ha senso e porta molti vantaggi. Ulteriori informazioni, video di realtà virtuale e ritratti dei nostri studenti possono essere trovati su www.armee.ch/lehre.

Le donne sono ancora sottorappresentate nella nostra unità amministrativa. Le vostre applicazioni sono quindi particolarmente gradite.
descriptionByLocale.en:
## Put to the Point

Are you interested in modern conveyance and storage systems, can you imagine keeping an overview in hectic situations and serving customers with the desired material? Are you interested in organization, data management and direct contact with customers? Then the varied 3-year training with us is exactly the right thing.

- Date of entry: 01.08.2027
- Type of employment: temporary
- Reference No: JRQ$540-19448
- Location: Route du PAA, 1772 Grolley

You can make this contribution

- Accepting goods, checking and recording them in the computer system, checking delivery documents and data and storing the goods properly

- Inspect stocks, carry out relocations, assemble goods for customer orders (picking), transport them through the warehouse operation and prepare them for delivery

- Packing, loading and securing the goods properly in lorries or railway wagons

- Serving the customer directly at the counter or ramp

- Execution by post

This makes you unique

- Completed compulsory schooling (secondary level or 10th school year) with good grades in mathematical subjects

- Logical thinking and exact working methods

- Reliability and responsibility

- Teamwork and good manners

- Robust physical condition

We offer this

- We are committed to the success model Switzerland and work for the benefit of the population.

- Thanks to equal opportunities, we develop our skills and bring in different perspectives.

- Healthy at work We support and advise our employees in the field of physical and mental health.

Diversity, dynamism, perspectives – teaching professions of the Swiss Army
The logistics base of the Swiss Army (LBA) is there for the force. It provides all logistical services for the Swiss army and manages the materials, systems and infrastructure of the Swiss army with its approximately 3'500 employees and 12,000 militia members. Whether in the workshop or in the office, inside or outside: The LBA offers a wide range of workplaces throughout Switzerland. We have something for everyone.

The Swiss Army employs more than 9,000 people in four military and around 200 civilian occupations – at 110 locations throughout Switzerland. The next generation is also taken care of: The Swiss Army trains learners in more than 30 professions.

## Additional information

An apprenticeship with the Swiss army makes sense and brings many advantages. Further information, virtual reality videos and portraits of our learners can be found at www.armee.ch/lehre.

Women are still underrepresented in our administrative unit. Your applications are therefore particularly welcome.

jobs.title: Lernende/-r Polymechaniker/-in EFZ
jobs.description:
## Auf den Punkt gebracht

Bei einer Lehre in unserer Lehrwerkstatt in Sitten kannst du deine technischen Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und an modernen Instrumenten einsetzen. Dank einer voll und ganz auf die Ausbildung ausgerichteten, professionellen Betreuung und deiner Motivation steht deinem Erfolg in der Lehre nichts im Weg.

- Eintrittsdatum: 16.08.2027
- Anstellungsart: befristet
- Referenz-Nr.: JRQ$540-19592
- Arbeitsort: Pont des Iles 2, 1950 Sion

Diesen Beitrag kannst du leisten

- Mechanische Teile mit gängigen Werkzeugmaschinen und/oder mit CNC-Maschinen verarbeiten

- Montage- und Wartungsarbeiten an mechanischen Geräten ausführen

- Mechanische Teile mithilfe von professioneller CAE/CAD-Software entwickeln und zeichnen

- Technische Berichte und Messprotokolle erstellen

- Geräte führen und unterhalten

Das macht dich einzigartig

- Abschluss der obligatorischen Schulzeit mit guten Noten, insbesondere in Mathematik

- Interesse an der Mechanik

- Handwerkliches Geschick

- Gute Beobachtungsgabe, methodische Arbeitsweise und Freude an sorgfältiger und exakter Arbeit

- Fähigkeit zur Teamarbeit und respektvoller Umgang mit Mitarbeitenden und dem Umfeld

Das bieten wir

- Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.

- Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.

- Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.

Vielfalt, Dynamik, Perspektiven – Lehrberufe der Schweizer Armee
Das Kommando Operationen (Kdo Op) ist für alle militärischen Operationen und Einsätze der Schweizer Armee verantwortlich. Zum Kdo Op gehören u. a. die Luftwaffe, das Heer, die vier Territorialdivisionen, das Kompetenzzentrum SWISSINT, das Kommando Spezialkräfte sowie die Militärpolizei. Rund 40 % der ca. 2'500 Mitarbeitenden sind zivil angestellt – von Ingenieur/-innen über Luftfahrzeugmechaniker/-innen bis hin zu Analyst/-innen.

Die Schweizer Armee beschäftigt über 9'000 Mitarbeitende in vier militärischen und rund 200 zivilen Berufen – und dies an 110 Standorten schweizweit. Auch für den Nachwuchs ist gesorgt: Die Schweizer Armee bildet in über 30 Berufen Lernende aus.

## Zusätzliche Informationen

Haben wir dein Interesse für diese Ausbildung geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf und Schulzeugnissen der letzten zwei Jahre bis am 1. Dezember 2026.
Du hast die Möglichkeit, unsere Lehrwerkstatt am nächsten Tag der offenen Tür, am Mittwoch, 28. Oktober 2026, von 13.30 bis 16.00 Uhr zu besuchen. Zudem sind zweitägige Schnupperlehren im Rahmen der verfügbaren Plätze möglich.
Eine Lehre bei der Schweizer Armee macht Sinn und bringt viele Vorteile mit sich. Überzeuge dich auf armee.ch/lehre.

Are you looking forward to being self-employed in vehicles from Mercedes Sprinter to trucks on the roads of Switzerland and do you already feel comfortable in traffic today? Then you are exactly right with us!
As part of your training, you will get an exciting insight into the varied tasks of the transport sector, you will learn to take responsibility, make decisions and cultivate customer and team contact with your team skills. With us you become a talent in and around our vehicles and get the opportunity to gain your first experience in freight transport and to serve special places and objects of the Swiss Army.
Do you feel addressed? We look forward to your application to lay the foundation for your professional future together.

- Plan, prepare and carry out transports in the Mittelland, so that all army material from the teddy bear to the youth and sports material to the ammunition is in the right place at the right time

- Minor repairs, maintenance and cleaning of trucks and trailers

- Loading, unloading and returning the goods by means of pallet wagons and forklifts

- control transport documents; Know and comply with safety regulations

- Acquire the driving licences of categories B, BE, C, CE, C1, C1E and forklifts and take the ADR/SDR exam

This makes you unique

- Completed compulsory schooling and reached 16. Year of age before 1 December of 1st year of apprenticeship

- Reliable, trustworthy, inquisitive

- Organizational ability and good comprehension with a strong willingness to learn

- Teamwork and good manners

- logical thinking with an exact working method

We offer this

- We are committed to the success model Switzerland and work for the benefit of the population.

- Through equal opportunities, we develop our skills and bring different perspectives.

Diversity, dynamism, perspectives – teaching professions of the Swiss Army

Diversity, dynamism, perspectives – teaching professions of the Swiss Army
The training command (Kdo Ausb) is responsible for training within the Swiss army – from recruitment to general basic training to cadre training for the militia and the professional military. The Kdo Ausb includes the higher cadre training, the personnel of the army, five teaching associations, the training center as well as the Women in the Army and Diversity Department. One third of the approximately 2,350 employees work in civilian professions in the scientific, technical, medical, psychological, administrative or sports sector and contribute to success together with the professional military.

The Swiss Army employs more than 9,000 people in four military and around 200 civilian occupations – at 110 locations throughout Switzerland. The next generation is also taken care of: The Swiss Army trains learners in more than 30 professions.

## Additional information

Your place of work and learning is the Waffenplatzküche Rettungstruppen in CH-3380 Wangen an der Aare.
An apprenticeship with the Swiss army makes sense and brings many advantages. With us you benefit from a comprehensive network and from the language diversity of the army members. Leadership and training skills as well as comprehensive professional support are among our strengths. Convince yourself on www.armee.ch/lehre.

Women are still underrepresented in our administrative unit. Your applications are therefore particularly welcome.

Non un lavoro ordinario, ma un compito con significato, varietà e forti prospettive di sviluppo. - Tipo di lavoro: perpetuo
- Numero di riferimento: JRQ$540-16680

- Come ufficiale professionista addestrato, rendere la prossima generazione adatta alle sfide di domani: sviluppare concetti di formazione e formazione quadri di milizia in fondamentali militari, leadership e tattiche

- Pianificare e dirigere le operazioni militari come esperto di comando e pianificazione operativa

- Fare una carriera e, grazie alla formazione aggiuntiva, assumere compiti di gestione responsabili in personale, scuole e corsi

- Assumendo la responsabilità di leadership nelle missioni di pace, nelle operazioni di aiuto umanitario o in altre operazioni in patria e all’estero e rappresentando gli interessi militari della Svizzera

Questo li rende unici.

- Ufficiale (Lt, Oblt, Hptm, Maj) dell'esercito svizzero e pronto per il prossimo passo

- Per il corso di laurea: Maturità o grado equivalente da una scuola di stato approvato e max. 31 anni ; per il corso di diploma (DAS): Completamento di un'università o FH e max. 35 anni

- Estratto corretto dal registro penale e di applicazione e patente di guida del Cat. B

- Buon fitness e team player che risponde in modo flessibile alle nuove sfide

- Volontà di lavorare ore irregolari e luoghi di lavoro mutevoli in patria e all'estero

- Conoscenza di una seconda lingua ufficiale (B1) e inglese (B1 per corso di laurea / B2 per corso di diploma)

Offriamo questo

- Siamo impegnati nel modello di successo svizzero e lavoriamo a beneficio della popolazione.

- Grazie alle pari opportunità, sviluppiamo le nostre competenze e realizziamo prospettive diverse.

- Salute al lavoro Sosteniamo e consigliamo i nostri dipendenti nel campo della salute fisica e mentale.

Il vostro impegno per la sicurezza e la libertà
L'esercito svizzero garantisce la sovranità del nostro paese e garantisce la sicurezza di tutti i residenti. La sua missione è sancita nella Costituzione federale e comprende la difesa della Svizzera, il soccorso alle catastrofi e la costruzione della pace all'estero.
Il personale militare professionale – sia che gli ufficiali o gli ufficiali non autorizzati – danno un contributo importante alla realizzazione di questi compiti, sia come istruttori nelle scuole che nei corsi di formazione, nel personale o durante le missioni in patria e all'estero. Il loro impegno fa la differenza, sia per l'esercito che per la Svizzera

Attendiamo con ansia i vostri documenti applicativi completi – questo include il vostro CV, certificati, diplomi, certificati di lingua e una copia della vostra patente di guida.

## Put to the Point

Assuming leadership responsibility, promoting people and making a significant contribution to Switzerland’s security – as an instructor, strategist/strategist and team player in one. Not an ordinary job, but a task with meaning, variety and strong development prospects. Become part of a team that takes responsibility and helps shape Switzerland’s security!

- Entry date: by agreement
- Type of employment: perpetual
- Reference No: JRQ$540-16680
- Place of work: Bolligenstrasse 56, 3006 Bern

You can make this contribution

- In a first step, complete a high-level, paid full-time education at the Military Academy of ETH Zurich and graduate with a Bachelor or Diploma of Advanced Studies (DAS)

- As a trained professional officer, make the next generation fit for tomorrow’s challenges: developing training concepts and training militia cadres in military fundamentals, leadership and tactics

- Planning and directing military operations as an expert in command and operational planning

- Make a career and, thanks to additional training, take on responsible management tasks in staffs, schools and courses

- Assuming leadership responsibility in peace missions, humanitarian aid operations or other operations at home and abroad and representing Switzerland’s military interests

This makes them unique.

- Officer (Lt, Oblt, Hptm, Maj) of the Swiss Army and ready for the next step

- For the bachelor course: Maturity or equivalent degree from a state-approved school as well as max. 31 years old ; for the diploma course (DAS): Completion of a university or FH as well as max. 35 years old

- Correct extract from the penal and enforcement register and driving licence of the Cat. B

- Good physical fitness and team player who responds flexibly to new challenges

- Willingness to work irregular hours and changing places of work at home and abroad

- Knowledge of a second official language (B1) and English (B1 for Bachelor course / B2 for Diploma course)

We offer this

- We are committed to the Swiss success model and work for the benefit of the population.

- Thanks to equal opportunities, we develop our skills and bring in different perspectives.

- Healthy at work We support and advise our employees in the field of physical and mental health.

Your commitment to security and freedom
The Swiss army guarantees the sovereignty of our country and ensures the security of all residents. Its mission is enshrined in the Federal Constitution and includes the defence of Switzerland, disaster relief and peacebuilding abroad.
Professional military personnel – whether officers or non-commissioned officers – make an important contribution to the fulfilment of these tasks, whether as instructors in schools and training courses, in the staffs or during missions at home and abroad. Their commitment makes the difference, both for the army and for Switzerland

## Additional information

We look forward to your complete application documents – this includes your CV, certificates, diplomas, any language certificates and a copy of your driving licence.
Good to know: In a second phase, a penal and enforcement register is requested.
Employing the Swiss army makes sense and brings many advantages. Learn more about the training and all the advantages on armee.ch/berufsmilitar.

Women are still underrepresented in our administrative unit. Your applications are therefore particularly welcome.

Ce n'est pas un travail ordinaire, mais une tâche avec un sens, une variété et de fortes perspectives de développement. Faites partie d'une équipe qui prend ses responsabilités et aide à façonner la sécurité de la Suisse !

- Date d'entrée: par accord
- Type d'emploi: perpétuel
- Numéro de référence: JRQ540-16680$
- Lieu de travail: Bolligenstrasse 56, 3006 Berne

## Auf den Punkt gebracht

Mit einer Lehre im Ausbildungszentrum des Flugplatzkommandos Payerne kannst du deine technischen Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und an modernen Instrumenten einsetzen. Dank einer voll und ganz auf die Ausbildung ausgerichteten, professionellen Betreuung und deiner Motivation steht deinem Erfolg in der Lehre nichts im Weg.

- Eintrittsdatum: 15.08.2026
- Anstellungsart: befristet
- Referenz-Nr.: JRQ$540-15681
- Arbeitsort: Caserne DCA, 1530 Payerne

Diesen Beitrag kannst du leisten

- Alle für die Elektronik relevanten Grundfertigkeiten erlernen: Elektronische Schaltkreise planen, herstellen, messen und prüfen sowie Software programmieren

- Elektronische Prototypen, elektronische Schaltungen, Testkonzepte und Embedded Software entwickeln

- Probleme anhand von Algorithmen (Prozesslogik) lösen

- Fachbereiche wie die Datenübermittlung, Systemkommunikation, Netzverwaltung und Robotik kennenlernen

Das macht dich einzigartig

- Sekundarschulabschluss oder gleichwertige Schulbildung

- Interesse an Technologie und insbesondere an Elektronik

- Logisches Denkvermögen und handwerkliches Geschick

- Motivation und Fähigkeit dafür, abstrakte Probleme zu lösen

- Lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

Das bieten wir

- Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.

- Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.

- Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.

Vielfalt, Dynamik, Perspektiven – Lehrberufe der Schweizer Armee
Das Kommando Operationen (Kdo Op) ist für alle militärischen Operationen und Einsätze der Schweizer Armee verantwortlich. Zum Kdo Op gehören u. a. die Luftwaffe, das Heer, die vier Territorialdivisionen, das Kompetenzzentrum SWISSINT, das Kommando Spezialkräfte sowie die Militärpolizei. Rund 40 % der ca. 2'500 Mitarbeitenden sind zivil angestellt – von Ingenieur/-innen über Luftfahrzeugmechaniker/-innen bis hin zu Analyst/-innen.

Die Schweizer Armee beschäftigt über 9'000 Mitarbeitende in vier militärischen und rund 200 zivilen Berufen – und dies an 110 Standorten schweizweit. Auch für den Nachwuchs ist gesorgt: Die Schweizer Armee bildet in über 30 Berufen Lernende aus.

Eine Lehre bei der Schweizer Armee macht Sinn und bringt viele Vorteile mit sich. Überzeuge dich auf armee.ch/lehre.

jobs.title: Chief Medical Officer
jobs.description:
## Auf den Punkt gebracht

Bereit, Medizin neu zu erleben?
Als Chief Medical Officer bei der SWISSCOY verbinden Sie ärztliches Know-how mit internationaler Zusammenarbeit. Sie übernehmen Verantwortung im Rahmen der Friedensförderung, gestalten den medizinischen Alltag aktiv mit und sammeln wertvolle Erfahrungen – weit weg von klassischen Klinikstrukturen.
Ob Sie Ihre Karriere gerade ausbauen oder kurz vor einem wohlverdienten Abschluss stehen, diese Erfahrung wird Sie beruflich und persönlich bereichern.

- Eintrittsdatum: à convenir
- Anstellungsart: befristet
- Referenz-Nr.: JRQ$540-14706
- Arbeitsort: Pristina, Kosovo

Diesen Beitrag können Sie leisten

- Verantwortung übernehmen und das Schweizer Medical Center im Kosovo Force (KFOR)-Hauptquartier in Pristina sowie ein engagiertes medizinisches Team leiten

- Die Angehörigen des Schweizer Kontingents von der allgemeinen Diagnostik bis hin zur Notfallversorgung medizinisch betreuen und Entscheidungen über weitere Behandlungsschritte treffen

- Den nationalen Kontingentskommandanten in medizinischen Fragen beraten und eng mit internationalen Partnern, insbesondere Österreich, zusammenarbeiten

- Spezialteams wie die EOD-Einheiten (Sprengstoffexperten/-innen) begleiten und die sanitätsdienstliche Versorgung sichern

- Gesundheitsmanagement der SWISSCOY weiterentwickeln und Teammitglieder sowie Truppenangehörige ausbilden

Das macht Sie einzigartig

- Abgeschlossenes Medizinstudium mit Facharzttitel (z. B. Anästhesie, Allgemeine Innere, Innere Medizin, Chirurgie etc.), militärmedizinisch oder notfallmedizinischen Erfahrungen von Vorteil

- Personen ohne militärische Grundausbildung werden der Funktion entsprechend ausgebildet

- Entscheidungsfreudig, flexibel und ein kühler Kopf, um auch unter Druck präzise und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten

- Fahrausweis der Kategorie B

- Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau und Englisch auf C1-Niveau, um mit internationalen Partnern und lokalen Teams effizient zu kommunizieren

Das bieten wir

- Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.

- Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.

- Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.

Sven Zillner
Sachbearbeiter I1
+41 58 467 58 58

Ihr Einsatz für Sicherheit und Freiheit
Das Kompetenzzentrum SWISSINT ist das nationale Einsatzführungskommando für die militärische Friedensförderung der Schweizer Armee und ist verantwortlich für die Planung, Bereitstellung und die nationale Führung aller schweizerischen militärischen Kontingente und Einzelpersonen im Armeeauftrag Friedensförderung.

## Zusätzliche Informationen

Alle weiteren Informationen zur Bewerbung und zu den nötigen Bewerbungsunterlagen finden Sie unter: www.peacekeeping.ch/bewerbung oder machen Sie sich hier ein genaueres Bild der Position.
Grundvoraussetzung für den Erhalt eines Einsatzvertrags ist das erfolgreiche Bestehen der einsatzbezogenen Ausbildung am Standort von SWISSINT in Stans-Oberdorf.

Frauen sind in unserer Verwaltungseinheit noch untervertreten. Ihre Bewerbungen sind daher besonders willkommen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In sintesi

Pronto/a a vivere la medicina in modo nuovo?
In qualità di Chief Medical Officer presso SWISSCOY, unisce le competenze mediche alla collaborazione internazionale. Si assume la responsabilità nell’ambito della promozione della pace, contribuisce attivamente a plasmare la quotidianità medica e acquisisce preziose esperienze, lontano dalle strutture cliniche tradizionali.
Che stia costruendo la sua carriera o sia poco prima di un meritato traguardo, questa esperienza la arricchirà professionalmente e personalmente.

- Data d’inizio: da concordare
- Tipo di contratto: a tempo determinato
- N. di riferimento: JRQ$540-14706
- Luogo di lavoro: Pristina, Kosovo

Questo è il contributo che può offrire

- Assumere la responsabilità e dirigere lo Swiss Medical Center presso il quartier generale della Kosovo Force (KFOR) a Pristina, nonché un team medico motivato

- Fornire assistenza medica ai membri del contingente svizzero, dalla diagnostica generale all’assistenza d’emergenza, e prendere decisioni sulle successive fasi del trattamento

- Consigliare il comandante nazionale del contingente sulle questioni mediche e collaborare strettamente con partner internazionali, in particolare con l’Austria

- Accompagnare squadre speciali come le unità EOD (specialisti/e di esplosivi) e garantire l’assistenza sanitaria

- Sviluppare ulteriormente la gestione sanitaria della SWISSCOY e formare i membri del team e il personale delle truppe

Ciò che la contraddistingue

- Laurea in medicina con titolo di medico specialista (ad es. anestesia, medicina interna generale, medicina interna, chirurgia ecc.); costituiscono un vantaggio esperienze in medicina militare o medicina d’urgenza

- Le persone senza una formazione militare di base riceveranno una formazione adeguata all’incarico

- Capacità decisionale, flessibilità e sangue freddo per lavorare con precisione e orientamento alle soluzioni anche sotto pressione

- Patente di guida di categoria B

- Conoscenza del tedesco almeno a livello B2 e dell’inglese a livello C1, per comunicare in modo efficiente con partner internazionali e team locali

Cosa offriamo

- Lavorare per la Svizzera Ci impegniamo per il modello di successo svizzero e lavoriamo per il bene della popolazione.

- Diversità vissuta Grazie alle pari opportunità sviluppiamo le nostre competenze e apportiamo prospettive diverse.

- Salute sul posto di lavoro Sosteniamo e consigliamo il nostro personale nell’ambito della salute fisica e mentale.

Sven Zillner
Impiegato amministrativo I1
+41 58 467 58 58

Il vostro impegno per la sicurezza e la libertà
Il Centro di competenza SWISSINT è il comando nazionale per la condotta degli impieghi per la promozione militare della pace dell’Esercito svizzero ed è responsabile della pianificazione, della messa a disposizione e della condotta a livello nazionale di tutti i contingenti militari svizzeri e di tutte le persone singole svizzere nell’ambito dell’incarico dell’Esercito per la promozione della pace.

Ulteriori informazioni

Tutte le ulteriori informazioni sulla candidatura e sulla documentazione necessaria sono disponibili all’indirizzo: www.peacekeeping.ch/bewerbung oppure qui potete farvi un’idea più precisa della posizione.
Condizione fondamentale per ottenere un contratto d’impiego è il superamento con successo della formazione specifica per l’impiego presso la sede di SWISSINT a Stans-Oberdorf.

Le donne sono ancora sottorappresentate nella nostra unità amministrativa. Le loro candidature sono pertanto particolarmente benvenute.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In a nutshell

Ready to experience medicine in a new way?
As Chief Medical Officer at SWISSCOY, you combine medical expertise with international cooperation. You take on responsibility as part of peace promotion efforts, actively shape day-to-day medical work and gain valuable experience – far from conventional hospital structures.
Whether you are currently advancing your career or are on the verge of a well-deserved graduation, this experience will enrich you both professionally and personally.

- Start date: to be agreed
- Employment type: fixed-term
- Reference no.: JRQ$540-14706
- Work location: Pristina, Kosovo

What you can contribute

- Assume responsibility for and lead the Swiss Medical Center at the Kosovo Force (KFOR) headquarters in Pristina, as well as a dedicated medical team

- Provide medical care to members of the Swiss contingent, from general diagnostics to emergency care, and make decisions about further treatment steps

- Advise the national contingent commander on medical matters and work closely with international partners, especially Austria

- Accompany specialist teams such as EOD units (explosives specialists) and ensure medical support

- Further develop the health management of SWISSCOY and train team members and troop personnel

What makes you unique

- Completed medical degree with a specialist qualification (e.g. anesthesiology, general internal medicine, internal medicine, surgery, etc.); experience in military or emergency medicine is an advantage

- People without basic military training will receive training appropriate to the role

- Decisive, flexible and able to keep a cool head in order to work precisely and in a solution-oriented manner even under pressure

- Category B driving licence

- German language skills at least at B2 level and English at C1 level, in order to communicate efficiently with international partners and local teams

What we offer

- Working for Switzerland We are committed to the Swiss success model and work for the benefit of the population.

- Diversity in practice Thanks to equal opportunities, we develop our skills and contribute different perspectives.

- Healthy at work We support and advise our employees on matters relating to physical and mental health.

Sven Zillner
Administrative officer I1
+41 58 467 58 58

Your commitment to security and freedom
The SWISSINT Competence Center is the national operational command for military peace promotion for the Swiss Armed Forces and is responsible for planning, provision and national command of all Swiss military contingents and individuals assigned to the Army's peace promotion mission.

Additional information

You can find all further information about applying and the required application documents at: www.peacekeeping.ch/bewerbung or get a more detailed impression of the position here.
A basic requirement for receiving a deployment contract is successfully completing the mission-specific training at SWISSINT's site in Stans-Oberdorf.

Women are still underrepresented in our administrative unit. We therefore particularly welcome your applications.

En bref

Prêt à vivre la médecine autrement ?
En tant que Chief Medical Officer au sein de la SWISSCOY, vous associez votre savoir-faire médical à la coopération internationale. Vous assumez des responsabilités dans le cadre de la promotion de la paix, contribuez activement à l’organisation du quotidien médical et acquérez une expérience précieuse, loin des structures hospitalières classiques.
Que vous soyez en train de développer votre carrière ou que vous soyez sur le point d’achever une étape bien méritée, cette expérience vous enrichira professionnellement et personnellement.

- Date d’entrée en fonction : à convenir
- Type de contrat : à durée déterminée
- N° de référence : JRQ$540-14706
- Lieu de travail : Pristina, Kosovo

Voici comment vous pouvez contribuer

- Assumer la responsabilité du centre médical suisse au quartier général de la Kosovo Force (KFOR) à Pristina et diriger une équipe médicale engagée

- Assurer la prise en charge médicale des membres du contingent suisse, du diagnostic général aux soins d’urgence, et prendre des décisions concernant la suite du traitement

- Conseiller le commandant national du contingent sur les questions médicales et collaborer étroitement avec des partenaires internationaux, notamment l’Autriche

- Les personnes n’ayant pas suivi de formation militaire de base reçoivent une formation adaptée à la fonction

- Faire preuve d’esprit de décision, de flexibilité et de sang-froid pour travailler avec précision, dans une approche orientée solutions, même sous pression

- En bonne santé au travail Nous soutenons et conseillons nos collaborateurs dans le domaine de la santé physique et mentale.

- Anstellungsart: befristet
- Referenz-Nr.: JRQ$540-9650

Sei emozionato per il trasporto e la logistica? Funzionamento veicoli più grandi ti dà piacere e si desidera acquisire esperienza all'estero? Quindi assicuratevi che i trasporti e i convogli SWISSCOY raggiungano la loro destinazione in modo sicuro e puntuale. Questa è la tua occasione – applica ora!
Il SWISSINT Competence Center recluta costantemente specialisti per missioni temporanee all'estero per promuovere la pace nell'esercito svizzero. Per questi incarichi, le donne e gli uomini interessati possono richiedere volontariamente per varie funzioni.

- Data di entrata: d'accordo
- Tipo di lavoro: temporaneo
- Numero di riferimento: JRQ$540-8493
- Luogo di lavoro: Pristina, Kosovo

Puoi dare questo contributo

- Trasporto di materiale, merci e passeggeri a beneficio di SWISSCOY e KFOR

- Lavorare per la pianificazione e l'attuazione dei convogli (ad esempio i convogli di fornitura tra l'area operativa e la Svizzera)

- Eseguire lavori di manutenzione e riparazione minori su veicoli ufficiali

- Responsabile della sicurezza delle merci trasportate e del rispetto delle norme di trasporto

- Gli sforzi situzionali per garantire la mobilità della KFOR nell'ambito dei disavanzi della libertà di movimento svizzera

Questo li rende unici.

- Formazione professionale completa, benefica nel trasporto e nella gestione di vari mezzi di trasporto (auto, cisterna e/o gru)

- Per la loro sicurezza e per la sicurezza dei compagni, nonché per una collaborazione fluida con colleghi austriaci e dipendenti locali, la conoscenza della lingua tedesca (minimo A1) è desiderata per questa funzione.

Offriamo questo

- Siamo impegnati al modello di successo Svizzera e lavoriamo a beneficio della popolazione.

- Attraverso pari opportunità, sviluppiamo le nostre competenze e portiamo diverse prospettive.

- Salute sul lavoro Sosteniamo e consigliamo i nostri dipendenti nel campo della salute fisica e mentale.

Per ulteriori informazioni rivolgersi a:

## Put to the Point

Are you excited about transport and logistics? Operating larger vehicles gives you pleasure and you want to gain experience abroad? Then you make sure that SWISSCOY transports and convoys reach their destination safely and on time. This is your chance – apply now!
The SWISSINT Competence Center is constantly recruiting specialists for temporary missions abroad to promote peace in the Swiss Army. For these assignments, interested women and men can apply voluntarily for various functions.

- Entry date: by agreement
- Type of employment: temporary
- Reference No: JRQ$540-8493
- Place of work: Pristina, Kosovo

You can make this contribution

- Carry out material, goods and passenger transport for the benefit of SWISSCOY and KFOR

- Working on planning and implementation of convoys (e.g. supply convoys between the operational area and Switzerland)

- Carry out minor maintenance and repair work on official vehicles

- Responsible for the safety of the transported goods and compliance with the transport regulations

- Situational efforts to ensure the mobility of KFOR as part of the Swiss Freedom of Movement Detachements

This makes them unique.

- Completed vocational training, beneficial in transport and handling various means of transport (lorry, car, tanker and/or crane)

- Completed recruiting school of the Swiss army, women with Swiss citizenship without basic military training are trained militarily according to their function

- Civil ticket (minimum Cat CE and/or D)

- For their own safety and for the safety of comrades as well as a smooth cooperation with Austrian colleagues and local employees, knowledge of the German language (minimum A1) is desired for this function.

We offer this

- We are committed to the success model Switzerland and work for the benefit of the population.

- Through equal opportunities, we develop our skills and bring different perspectives.

- Healthy at work We support and advise our employees in the field of physical and mental health.

Sven Zillner
+41 58 467 58 58

The SWISSINT Competence Center is the Swiss Army’s national operational command for military peacebuilding and is responsible for planning, deploying and nationally commanding all Swiss military contingents and individuals in the army’s peacebuilding mission.

## Additional information

Use for further information Please contact:
Recruitment team of the competence centre SWISSINT, tel: 058 467 58 58, e-mail: rekr.swissint@vtg.admin.ch
All further information about the application and the necessary application documents can be found at peacekeeping.ch/bewerbung.
The prerequisite for obtaining an assignment contract is the successful completion of the mission-related training at the SWISSINT site in Stans-Oberdorf.

Women are still underrepresented in our administrative unit. Your applications are therefore particularly welcome.

jobs.description:
## Auf den Punkt gebracht

Bei einer Lehre im Ausbildungszentrum des Flugplatzkommandos Payerne kannst du deine technischen Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln und an modernen Instrumenten einsetzen. Dank einer voll und ganz auf die Ausbildung ausgerichteten, professionellen Betreuung und deiner Motivation steht deinem Erfolg in der Lehre nichts im Weg.

- Anstellungsart: unbefristet
- Referenz-Nr.: JRQ$540-6632
- Arbeitsort: Caserne DCA, 1530 Payerne

Diesen Beitrag kannst du leisten

- Alle für die Elektronik relevanten Grundfertigkeiten erlernen: Elektronische Schaltkreise planen, herstellen, messen und prüfen sowie Software programmieren

- Elektronische Prototypen, elektronische Schaltungen, Testkonzepte und Embedded Software entwickeln

- Probleme anhand von Algorithmen (Prozesslogik) lösen

- Fachbereiche wie die Datenübermittlung, Systemkommunikation, Netzverwaltung und Robotik erlernen

Das macht dich einzigartig

- Sekundarschulabschluss oder gleichwertige Schulbildung

- Interesse an Technologie und insbesondere Elektronik

- Logisches Denkvermögen und handwerkliches Geschick

- Motivation, Verständnis für abstrakte Zusammenhänge sowie Lösungsorientiertheit

Das bieten wir

- Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.

- Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.

- Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.

Vielfalt, Dynamik, Perspektiven – Lehrberufe der Schweizer Armee
Das Kommando Operationen (Kdo Op) ist für alle militärischen Operationen und Einsätze der Schweizer Armee verantwortlich. Zum Kdo Op gehören u. a. die Luftwaffe, das Heer, die vier Territorialdivisionen, das Kompetenzzentrum SWISSINT, das Kommando Spezialkräfte sowie die Militärpolizei. Rund 40 % der ca. 2'500 Mitarbeitenden sind zivil angestellt – von Ingenieur/innen über Luftfahrzeugmechaniker/innen bis zu Pilot/innen.

Die Schweizer Armee beschäftigt über 9'000 Mitarbeitende in vier militärischen und rund 200 zivilen Berufen – und dies an 140 Standorten schweizweit. Auch für den Nachwuchs ist gesorgt: Die Schweizer Armee bildet in über 30 Berufen Lernende aus.

## Zusätzliche Informationen

Für weitere Auskünfte wende dich bitte an:
Jean-Yves Dupertuis, Berufsbildner, Tel. 058 466 29 38
Haben wir dein Interesse für diese Ausbildung geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf und Schulzeugnissen der letzten zwei Jahre bis am 27. Oktober 2023.
Eine Lehre bei der Schweizer Armee macht Sinn und bringt viele Vorteile mit sich. Überzeuge dich auf armee.ch/lehrberufe.

- Scopri tutte le competenze di base rilevanti per l'elettronica: progettazione, produzione, misurazione e test di circuiti elettronici e software di programmazione

- Sviluppare prototipi elettronici, circuiti elettronici, concetti di test e software incorporato

- Risolvere problemi utilizzando algoritmi (logiche di processo)

- Aree tematiche di apprendimento quali trasmissione dati, comunicazione di sistema, gestione della rete e robotica

- Motivazione, comprensione dei rapporti astratti e orientamento della soluzione

- Tipo di lavoro: temporaneo
- Numero di riferimento: JRQ$540-7235

- Conoscenza molto buona dell'inglese, la conoscenza di una seconda lingua ufficiale è vantaggiosa

Offriamo questo

- Siamo impegnati al modello di successo Svizzera e lavoriamo a beneficio della popolazione.

- Grazie alle pari opportunità, sviluppiamo le nostre competenze e realizziamo prospettive diverse.

- Salute sul lavoro Sosteniamo e consigliamo i nostri dipendenti nel campo della salute fisica e mentale.

+41 58 467 58 58

## Auf den Punkt gebracht

Das Kompetenzzentrum SWISSINT rekrutiert laufend Fachpersonen für befristete Auslandseinsätze zugunsten der Friedensförderung der Schweizer Armee. Für diese Einsätze können sich interessierte Frauen und Männer für verschiedene Funktionen freiwillig bewerben.

- Referenz-Nr.: JRQ$540-7012

- Dynamische, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit Eigeninitiative und Teamfähigkeit sowie ein positiver Umgang mit hohem Arbeitsvolumen

- Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.

- Tipo di lavoro: temporaneo
- Numero di riferimento: JRQ$540-7012
- Posizione: Pristina, Kosovo

Offriamo questo

- Grazie alle pari opportunità, sviluppiamo le nostre competenze e realizziamo prospettive diverse.

Il SWISSINT Competence Center è il comando operativo nazionale per la promozione della pace militare dell'esercito svizzero ed è responsabile per la pianificazione, la fornitura e la leadership nazionale di tutti i contingenti militari e individui svizzeri nella promozione della pace dell'ordine militare.

## Put to the Point

Are you an open personality and like to communicate with international partners? Are you interested in world affairs and are excited about news gathering? This is your chance – we look forward to your application!
The Swiss Armed Forces Competence Centre SWISSINT is constantly recruiting specialists for temporary missions abroad in order to promote peace in the Swiss army. For these assignments, interested women and men can apply voluntarily for various functions.

- Entry date: by agreement
- Type of employment: temporary
- Reference No: JRQ$540-7012
- Location: Pristina, Kosovo

You can make this contribution

- Plan, coordinate and direct the surveillance operations conducted by ISR Bn (Intelligence Surveillance and Reconnaissance Battalion KFOR)

- Creating operational planning

- Coordinate the needs of assigned units or subordinate personnel

- Assess the development of the situation and use it to create news needs, which are issued to the ISR teams

- Improve the information flow and synchronization with supervisors and subordinates

This makes them unique.

- Completed cadre training of the Swiss Army, staff experience at troop body level advantageous

- Very good analytical and editorial skills in English

- Dynamic, communicative personality with initiative and teamwork as well as a positive approach to high work volume

- Civil ticket (category B1)

- For own safety and the safety of comrades as well as for smooth cooperation with Austrian colleagues and local employees, knowledge of the German (minimum B2) and English language (minimum C1) is required for this function.

We offer this

- We are committed to the success model Switzerland and work for the benefit of the population.

- Thanks to equal opportunities, we develop our skills and bring in different perspectives.

- Healthy at work We support and advise our employees in the field of physical and mental health.

Sven Zillner
+41 58 467 58 58

Your commitment to security and freedom
The SWISSINT Competence Center is the national operational command for the military peace promotion of the Swiss Army and is responsible for the planning, provision and national leadership of all Swiss military contingents and individuals in the army order peace promotion.

## Additional information

Use for further information Please contact:
Recruitment team of the competence centre SWISSINT,
Tel: 058 467 58 58, e-mail: rekr.swissint@vtg.admin.ch
All further information about the application and the necessary application documents can be found at www.peacekeeping.ch/bewerbung.
The basic prerequisite for obtaining an assignment contract is the successful completion of the mission-related training at the SWISSINT location in Stans-Oberdorf.

Women are still underrepresented in our administrative unit. Your applications are therefore particularly welcome.

## Metti al punto

Il Centro di Competenza delle Forze Armate Svizzere SWISSINT recluta costantemente specialisti per missioni temporanee all'estero per promuovere la pace nell'esercito svizzero. Per questi incarichi, le donne e gli uomini interessati possono richiedere volontariamente per varie funzioni.

- Data di entrata: d'accordo
- Tipo di lavoro: temporaneo
- Numero di riferimento: JRQ$540-7011
- Posizione: Pristina, Kosovo

Puoi dare questo contributo

- Monitorare il tracciamento della situazione da parte dei Watchkeepers (MOVCON) e le informazioni in arrivo del triage secondo la loro importanza a favore della gestione operativa

- Misure coordinate in caso di incidente tra il quartier generale KFOR (HQ KFOR) e le rispettive unità KFOR in loco

- Creare il report di situazione del Comando Regionale ogni giorno e gestire il sistema di gestione dei dati per l'area S3

- Agire come hub tra i team nazionali di collegamento e monitoraggio e il comando regionale

- Partecipa alla creazione di ordini a livello di Comando Regionale

Questo li rende unici.

- Competenze analitiche e editoriali molto buone in inglese

- Personalità dinamica e comunicativa con iniziativa e lavoro di squadra e un approccio positivo al volume di lavoro elevato

- Biglietto civile (categoria B1)

- Per la propria sicurezza e la sicurezza dei compagni, nonché per una collaborazione regolare con colleghi austriaci e dipendenti locali, è necessaria la conoscenza della lingua tedesca (minimo B2) e inglese (minimo C1).

Offriamo questo

- Siamo impegnati al modello di successo Svizzera e lavoriamo a beneficio della popolazione.

- Grazie alle pari opportunità, sviluppiamo le nostre competenze e realizziamo prospettive diverse.

- Salute sul lavoro Sosteniamo e consigliamo i nostri dipendenti nel campo della salute fisica e mentale.

Sven Zillner
+41 58 467 58 58

Il vostro impegno per la sicurezza e la libertà
Il SWISSINT Competence Center è il comando operativo nazionale per la promozione della pace militare dell'esercito svizzero ed è responsabile per la pianificazione, la fornitura e la leadership nazionale di tutti i contingenti militari e individui svizzeri nella promozione della pace dell'ordine militare.

## Put to the Point

Are you an open personality and like to communicate with international partners? In this turntable function, you analyze the operational situation development and write daily situation reports. This is your chance – we look forward to your application!
The Swiss Armed Forces Competence Centre SWISSINT is constantly recruiting specialists for temporary missions abroad in order to promote peace in the Swiss army. For these assignments, interested women and men can apply voluntarily for various functions.

- Entry date: by agreement
- Type of employment: temporary
- Reference No: JRQ$540-7011
- Location: Pristina, Kosovo

You can make this contribution

- Monitor the situational tracking by the Watchkeepers (MOVCON) and triage incoming information according to their importance in favor of operational management

- Coordinate measures in the event of an incident between the headquarters KFOR (HQ KFOR) and the respective KFOR units on site

- Create the situational report of the Regional Command every day and manage the data handling system for the S3 area

- Act as a hub between the National Liaison and Monitoring Teams and the Regional Command

- Participate in the creation of orders at Regional Command level

This makes them unique.

- Completed officer school of the Swiss Army, cadre training up to troop body of advantage

- Very good analytical and editorial skills in English

- Dynamic, communicative personality with initiative and teamwork as well as a positive approach to high work volume

- Civil ticket (category B1)

- For own safety and the safety of comrades as well as for smooth cooperation with Austrian colleagues and local employees, knowledge of the German (minimum B2) and English language (minimum C1) is required for this function.

We offer this

- We are committed to the success model Switzerland and work for the benefit of the population.

- Thanks to equal opportunities, we develop our skills and bring in different perspectives.

- Healthy at work We support and advise our employees in the field of physical and mental health.

+41 58 467 58 58

jobs.description:

Das Kompetenzzentrum SWISSINT rekrutiert laufend Fachleute für befristete Auslandseinsätze zu Gunsten der Friedensförderung der Schweizer Armee. Basierend auf der Freiwilligkeit dieser Einsätze können sich interessierte Frauen und Männer für verschiedene Funktionen bewerben. Grundvoraussetzung für den Erhalt eines Einsatzvertrags ist das erfolgreiche Bestehen der einsatzbezogenen Ausbildung am Standort von SWISSINT in Stans-Oberdorf.

- Anstellungsart: unbefristet
- Arbeitsort: Kasernenstrasse 4, 6370 Stans-Oberdorf

Ihre Aufgaben

- Instandhaltung und Instandstellung schwerer und leichter Motorwagen

- Durchführen von Reparaturen jeglicher Art

- Mithilfe für den Unterhalt der Stromaggregate

- Konservierung der sensitiven Fahrzeugbereiche

Das macht Sie einzigartig

- Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Automobil-Mechatroniker/in (Fachrichtung Personenwagen oder Nutzfahrzeuge) und/oder Landmaschinenmechaniker/in

- Zur eigenen Sicherheit und zur Sicherheit der Kameradinnen und Kameraden sowie einer reibungslosen Zusammenarbeit mit österreichischen Kollegen/innen und lokal angestellten Personen, sind für diese Funktion Kenntnisse der deutschen Sprache (mind. A1) erwünscht

- Ziviler Führerausweis (Kat CE und/oder D)

- Alter zwischen 18 und 65 Jahren

- Abgeschlossene Rekrutenschule der Schweizer Armee, Frauen mit Schweizer Staatsbürgerschaft ohne militärische Grundausbildung werden der Funktion entsprechend militärisch ausgebildet

Das bieten wir

- Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.

- Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.

## Metti al punto

Promuovere la pace – la nostra missione
Il Centro di Competenza delle Forze Armate Svizzere SWISSINT recluta costantemente esperti per missioni temporanee all'estero per promuovere la pace nell'esercito svizzero. Sulla base del volontario di questi incarichi, le donne e gli uomini interessati possono richiedere varie funzioni. Il prerequisito per l'ottenimento di un contratto di assegnazione è il completamento con successo della formazione relativa alla missione presso il sito SWISSINT di Stans-Oberdorf.

- Tipo di lavoro: perpetuo
- Luogo di lavoro: Kasernenstrasse 4, 6370 Stans-Oberdorf

I loro compiti
I tuoi doveri come membro della squadra
- Istituzione, smantellamento e conversione delle infrastrutture nazionali e internazionali a nome del Gruppo KFOR Joint Logistics Support (JLSG)

- Conservazione del valore e miglioramento permanente delle misure di indurimento proprie di KFOR per l’autoprotezione

- Specialista nell'associazione di una libertà di movimento Detachements (FoMD) di KFOR

- Fornitori di servizi completi nel campo della costruzione

I tuoi doveri come cadre
- Gestione del personale assegnato e dell'uso economico delle risorse nonché della responsabilità per la sicurezza e la tutela della salute sul lavoro nella propria area

- Pianificazione e gestione delle operazioni nel quadro internazionale di un FoMD, nonché nella fornitura di servizi a beneficio del JLSG di KFOR

- Partecipazione agli esercizi internazionali e successivamente al trattamento operativo delle lezioni apprese nell'ambito della FoMD di KFOR

- Pianificazione e realizzazione di progetti di costruzione nazionali e internazionali e manutenzione

Questo li rende unici.

- Formazione professionale completa in costruzioni o studi completi in ingegneria civile

- Per la loro sicurezza e per la sicurezza dei compagni e per una collaborazione fluida con colleghi austriaci e dipendenti locali, la conoscenza della lingua tedesca (livello secondo la funzione) è desiderata per questa funzione.

- Conoscenza della lingua inglese (livello a seconda della funzione)

- Patente di guida civile (cat B)

- Età compresa tra 18 e 65

- Completata la scuola di reclutamento dell'esercito svizzero, le donne con cittadinanza svizzera senza formazione militare di base sono addestrate militarmente secondo la loro funzione

Offriamo questo

- Siamo impegnati al modello di successo Svizzera e lavoriamo a beneficio della popolazione.

- Grazie alle pari opportunità, sviluppiamo le nostre competenze e realizziamo prospettive diverse.

- Salute sul lavoro Sosteniamo e consigliamo i nostri dipendenti nel campo della salute fisica e mentale.

Il SWISSINT Competence Center è il comando operativo nazionale per la promozione della pace militare dell'esercito svizzero ed è responsabile per la pianificazione, la fornitura e la leadership nazionale di tutti i contingenti militari e individui svizzeri nella promozione della pace dell'ordine militare.

## Ulteriori informazioni

Per ulteriori informazioni rivolgersi al Centro di competenza SWISSINT, Tel. 058 467 58.
I moduli di domanda sono disponibili su: www.peace-support.ch

L'Amministrazione federale rispetta le diverse esigenze e le esperienze di vita dei suoi dipendenti e promuove la loro diversità. La parità di trattamento è una priorità assoluta.

## Put to the Point

Promoting peace – our mission
The Swiss Armed Forces Competence Centre SWISSINT is constantly recruiting experts for temporary missions abroad to promote peace in the Swiss army. Based on the voluntariness of these assignments, interested women and men can apply for various functions. The prerequisite for obtaining an assignment contract is the successful completion of the mission-related training at the SWISSINT site in Stans-Oberdorf.

- Type of employment: perpetual
- Place of work: Kasernenstrasse 4, 6370 Stans-Oberdorf

Their tasks
Your duties as a member of the team
- Establishment, dismantling and conversion of national and international infrastructures on behalf of the KFOR Joint Logistics Support Group (JLSG)

- Preservation of value and permanent improvement of KFOR’s own hardening measures for self-protection

- Specialist in the association of a Freedom of Movement Detachements (FoMD) of KFOR

- Complete service providers in the field of construction

Your duties as a cadre
- Management of assigned staff and economic use of resources as well as responsibility for occupational safety and health protection in their own area

- Operation planning and management in the international framework of a FoMD as well as in the provision of services for the benefit of the JLSG of KFOR

- Participation in international exercises and subsequently the operational processing of lessons learned within the framework of the FoMD of KFOR

- Planning and realization of national and international construction projects and ensuring maintenance

This makes them unique.

- Completed vocational training in construction or completed studies in civil engineering

- For their own safety and for the safety of comrades as well as a smooth cooperation with Austrian colleagues and local employees, knowledge of the German language (level depending on the function) is desired for this function.

- Knowledge of the English language (level depending on function)

- Civil driving licence (cat B)

- Age between 18 and 65

- Completed recruiting school of the Swiss army, women with Swiss citizenship without basic military training are trained militarily according to their function

We offer this

- We are committed to the success model Switzerland and work for the benefit of the population.

- Thanks to equal opportunities, we develop our skills and bring in different perspectives.

- Healthy at work We support and advise our employees in the field of physical and mental health.

The SWISSINT Competence Center is the national operational command for the military peace promotion of the Swiss Army and is responsible for the planning, provision and national leadership of all Swiss military contingents and individuals in the army order peace promotion.

## Additional information

For further information please contact the Competence Center SWISSINT, Tel. 058 467 58 58.
Application forms can be found at: www.peace-support.ch

The Federal Administration respects the different needs and life experiences of its employees and promotes their diversity. Equal treatment is a top priority.

## Put to the Point

Promoting peace – our mission
For various missions in Europe, Asia and Africa, we are constantly looking for officers for different functions. Interested women and men can apply to the SWISSINT Competence Center for a mission abroad on behalf of the Swiss Army to promote peace.

- Type of employment: perpetual
- Place of work: Kasernenstrasse 4, 6370 Stans-Oberdorf

Their tasks

- Assignment as an officer in NATO- or EU-led contingents, for example as location commander, team leader or staff officer

- Deployment in UN missions, for example as a military observer to monitor compliance with a ceasefire agreement or as a staff officer in headquarters

- Capacity building as a training officer and head of international courses in various training centres

This makes them unique.

- Completed apprenticeship or study, practical qualification and good repute

- Age between 25 and 55 years

- Military degree of the Swiss Army as first lieutenant, captain, major or lieutenant colonel

- Very good knowledge of English, French is an advantage

- Category B ticket

- Mental and physical resilience

- Ability to put personal interests in the background

- High willingness to work impartially for the mission in the international environment for several months

We offer this

- We are committed to the success model Switzerland and work for the benefit of the population.

- Thanks to equal opportunities, we develop our skills and bring in different perspectives.

- Healthy at work We support and advise our employees in the field of physical and mental health.

The SWISSINT Competence Center is the national operational command for the military peace promotion of the Swiss Army and is responsible for the planning, provision and national leadership of all Swiss military contingents and individuals in the army order peace promotion.

For further information please contact the Competence Center SWISSINT, Tel. 058 467 58 58.
Application forms can be found at: www.peace-support.ch
